reuse.why: The expected amount comes from the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same function the posting, preview and forecast paths use, and the list still goes through scheduleModel.toExternal.

duplication.why: No range or missing-amount logic is re-implemented; the handler only spreads the mapped schedule and adds one helper call.

placement.why: The list-only field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with its own APIScheduleListEntity type, which keeps create/update models unchanged; computing it inside the model mapper would have been equally natural.

scope.why: Only the handler, its return type, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A one-line delegation to the shared rule, so the API value follows any future change to the scheduled-amount rule automatically.
